description: One workspace for everything you do with AI: Claude Code, Codex and seven more coding agents side by side, one assistant that runs them, voice, and docs. Open source, on your computer, on your own plans and keys. Formerly Personal Jarvis.

latest_release.name: v5.6.0
latest_release.body:
### Added

- A picture sent with a message opens in full on a click (#1828)
- A clicked edit opens beside the conversation as its change, drawn like the Changes view (#1827)
- The Agents tab is a board of every thread and terminal agent, by pull request state (#1825)
- /btw side questions, and slash commands run again with an effort picked (#1821)
- The lead judges for itself how much a task needs; every node guide says how to work (#1824)
- The whiteboard gets a tool lock, a gold laser pointer, a lasso, a paint bucket and draw to shape (#1822)
- A multi-track video editor that Dodaios drives too (#1814)
- A presentation-program deck editor with free elements, backgrounds, design looks and a presenter view (#1812)
- Agents finish their own work by default, and each person sets how Dodaios briefs them (#1811)
- The whiteboard gets its own canvas: a tool dock, an inspector, gliding zoom, and the assistant drawing live (#1808)
- Remove the Visuals node type (#1809)
- A slash command shows in blue in the box and in the sent message (#1806)
- A file or folder an answer names opens beside the conversation (#1803)
- Show when a coding agent compacts its conversation (#1791)
- The agent's to-do list is simpler: a thin square frame around it, square boxes, no progress bar (#1783)

### Changed

- An engine on this computer reads the dictation while the person speaks (#1818)
- The recording picker opens at once on the shortcut (#1780)

### Fixed

- The side panel's File tab wraps long lines instead of scrolling sideways (#1830)
- Retired named agents no longer reach the lead or open the old Agents page (#1813)
- Ignore release dates in Hermes version detection (#1799)
- A registered word is found by its sound, however the recognizer spelled it (#1810)
- Read Claude logins and usage from the macOS Keychain (#1804)
- The browser window hides the moment Dodaios replaces the IDE (#1805)
- The Dodaios Bar draws sharp edges on Windows (#1800)
- The Dodaios chat opens at its last message after a restart and after another section (#1795)
- Two tests that broke on the calendar keep their clock fixed (#1801)
- Parallel calls of one tool show their own results in the trace (#1794)
- A round that only thought is asked again with thinking off, so the turn never ends empty (#1793)
- The model picker lists a browsed provider's local models (Ollama) before it is picked (#1792)
- The browser reads without asking and asks at the click that commits, with a card in the conversation (#1784)
- A turn carried on across an app restart takes a message mid-turn, so Send now no longer stops it and its sub-agents (#1789)
- The conversation beside a node no longer waits for a frame that may not come (#1790)
- A question card marks an option as recommended only when the agent recommends one (#1785)
- The node window is on screen at the click: its code is fetched ahead, its frame is drawn at once, and the conversation is moved beside the node instead of drawn again (#1787)
- The brief rules reach the lead where it writes, so its prompts to agents change (#1781)
- A Telegram approval shows the command and the diff in a code block, escaped for HTML only (#1772)
- Every loopback stand-in binds without the host name lookup that stalls on macOS (#1759)
- A thread row shows its agent's brand mark instead of a "CL" monogram (#1779)

detail.readme:
Dodaios

The meta-agent that sits above all your coding agents. Talk to one orchestrator in a single chat while Dodaios automatically dispatches, monitors, and syncs complex engineering tasks across every CLI, IDE, and local agent in your stack.

Install · Your plans · Documentation · Website · Discord · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Español · हिन्दी · العربية · Français · বাংলা · Português (Brasil) · Русский · Bahasa Indonesia

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/37cdc5a5-30d6-49c8-92ff-3454a075569f

A real recording at 60 frames a second, played at the speed it was filmed; the waits for the models are cut out. It was recorded with Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Opus 5.5 through Claude Code. The code change, test runs and commit are real. Watch the video (MP4, 42 s, 2.5 MB)

## Install macOS and Linux: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/main/install/install.sh | bash ``` Windows, in PowerShell: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/main/install/install.ps1 | iex ``` The installer sets up its own Python environment, adds a launcher and opens the app. On the first start you give the assistant a name (it is also the wake word), connect one model and choose how you want to talk to it. For coding work, install at least one coding agent, such as Claude Code or Codex, and sign in to it. ```bash dodaios # start the desktop app dodaios update # install the newest release ```
Desktop installers, pipx and servers
Download the installer for your system from the latest release: | Windows | macOS | Linux | | --- | --- | --- | | [Dodaios-Setup-x64.exe](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/releases/latest/download/Dodaios-Setup-x64.exe) | [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/releases/latest/download/Dodaios-macOS-arm64.dmg) · [Intel](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/releases/latest/download/Dodaios-macOS-x64.dmg) | [AppImage, x86_64](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/releases/latest/download/Dodaios-Linux-x86_64.AppImage) |
detail.readme_zh:
Dodaios

All your coding agents in one chat.
你所有的编程智能体，尽在一个对话里。

安装 · 你的套餐 · 文档 · 官网 · Discord · English · 日本語 · Español · हिन्दी · العربية · Français · বাংলা · Português (Brasil) · Русский · Bahasa Indonesia

> Ten terminals, Claude Code here, Codex there, and none of the agents knows what the others are doing. You copy context back and forth, write the same prompt three times and lose track of who changed what. Dodaios cleans that up: it's the tech lead above all your coding agents. It knows your projects, writes every brief, launches the right agents in its Agentic IDE and keeps watch. You stay in one chat, and Dodaios tells you when an agent is done or needs you. Even with 30 agents at once. > > Open source, and it runs on your computer. Works with your Claude or ChatGPT subscription, with API keys for Claude, OpenAI and Gemini, or with local Ollama models. 你在一个终端里开着 Claude Code，在另一个终端里开着 Codex，还有一个聊天标签页，用来把计划来回复制。Dodaios 终结了这一切。它是位于你所有编程智能体之上的一层：你用语音或聊天说出想要什么，一个助手就会接手。它撰写任务说明，在内置的 Agentic IDE 中启动合适的智能体，在其工作时持续关注，并在完成或需要你时通知你。同时运行五个智能体，依然清楚每一个做了什么。 开源，运行在你自己的电脑上。可使用你的 Claude 或 ChatGPT 订阅、Claude、OpenAI 和 Gemini 的 API 密钥，或本地 Ollama 模型。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/37cdc5a5-30d6-49c8-92ff-3454a075569f

A real recording at 60 frames a second, played at the speed it was filmed; the waits for the models are cut out. It was recorded with Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Opus 5.5 through Claude Code. The code change, test runs and commit are real. Watch the video (MP4, 42 s, 2.5 MB)

## 安装 macOS 和 Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/main/install/install.sh | bash ``` Windows，在 PowerShell 中： ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/main/install/install.ps1 | iex ``` 安装脚本会创建自己的 Python 环境，添加启动器并打开应用。首次启动时，你给助手起个名字（它同时也是唤醒词），连接一个模型，并选择你想怎样和它交流。要做编程工作，请至少安装一个编程智能体并登录，例如 Claude Code 或 Codex。 ```bash dodaios # 启动桌面应用 dodaios update # 安装最新版本 ```
桌面安装包、pipx 和服务器
从最新版本下载适合你系统的安装包： | Windows | macOS | Linux | | --- | --- | --- | | [Dodaios-Setup-x64.exe](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/releases/latest/download/Dodaios-Setup-x64.exe) | [Apple 芯片](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/releases/latest/download/Dodaios-macOS-arm64.dmg) · [Intel](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/releases/latest/download/Dodaios-macOS-x64.dmg) | [AppImage，x86_64](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/releases/latest/download/Dodaios-Linux-x86_64.AppImage) | 每个版本都在 `installers-SHA256SUMS.txt` 中列出校验和。安装包目前还没有签名：Windows 会显示警告，macOS 会要求你在“系统设置”的“隐私与安全性”中允许这个应用一次。[代码签名政策](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/code-signing-policy.md)说明了目前的进展。 用 pipx 可以得到体积更小的服务端软件包，不带桌面启动器。在没有屏幕的 Linux 服务器上，安装脚本接受 `--headless`，`dodaios serve` 只启动浏览器界面： ```bash pipx install dodaios curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/main/install/install.sh | bash -s -- --headless dodaios serve # 仅浏览器界面，适合没有屏幕的服务器 ``` Dodaios 运行在 64 位的 Windows、macOS 和基于 glibc 的 Linux 上。终端安装脚本支持 x86-64 和 Arm64，需要 Python 3.11 到 3.14 和 Git；它会获取缺少的 Python，缺少 Git 时会提出帮你安装。显卡不是必需的。目前只有 Windows 11 有记录在案的实机验收。 [安装指南](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/product/start-here/install-dodaios.md) · [平台支持](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/product/reference/platform-support.md) · [在服务器上运行](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/headless-vps-deployment.md)
## 你的套餐和密钥 Dodaios 不花钱：没有 Dodaios 账号，也没有付费版。它不出售模型访问权限，也不会替你登录。它会启动每个编程智能体的官方命令行工具，每一个都由你自己登录，所以这些智能体用的是你已有的套餐和密钥。例如，Claude Code 需要付费的 Claude 套餐。你对每项服务的使用都遵循该服务自己的条款。 [提供商与 API 密钥](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/product/personalize-and-connect/providers-and-api-keys.md) ## 须知 - **你的数据。** 聊天记录、记忆、文档和设置都是运行 Dodaios 的那台电脑上的文件。模型或已连接的服务，会得到它完成请求中自己那一部分所需的内容。登录 Google、Slack 或 Figma 插件会经过本项目运行的一个小型令牌服务。 [隐私与本地数据](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/product/privacy-safety-and-support/privacy-and-local-data.md) - **先询问。** 新聊天从“Bypass permissions”（跳过权限确认）开始，在这个模式下什么都不会询问。选择一个会询问的模式后，上面的四项硬性限制总是要等你同意。 [安全与审批](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/product/privacy-safety-and-support/safety-and-approvals.md) - **尚未完成的部分。** 电话通话需要你自己的 Twilio 号码，目前是早期预览。大多数插件仍带有“Preview”（预览版）标记。手机应用是由你的电脑提供的网页应用。 ## 文档 [功能导览](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/feature-tour.md)（英文）在一个页面上配图介绍了每个部分。同样的指南也在应用内的 **Docs** 页面里，并且可以搜索。 [首次运行设置](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/product/start-here/first-run-setup.md) · [故障排查](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/product/privacy-safety-and-support/troubleshooting.md) · [架构概览](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/docs/architecture-overview.md) ## 参与贡献 欢迎修复问题、补充测试、提交平台报告和完善文档。[贡献指南](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-contribution-in-10-minutes)能让你在大约十分钟内从 fork 走到一次通过的检查。问题和想法请到 [Discord](https://discord.gg/x7USduHxbc)。 感谢每一位在这里交付过成果的人，名单见[英文 README 的贡献者墙](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/README.md#contributing)。 ## 许可证 Dodaios 采用 [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/LICENSE) 许可，署名信息见 [NOTICE](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/NOTICE)。名称和标志受[商标政策](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/TRADEMARK.md)约束。Dodaios 是一个独立项目：它所配合使用的产品归其各自的开发者所有，Dodaios 支持某个工具，并不意味着该工具的开发者认可 Dodaios。Dodaios 在 2026 年 10 月之前叫 Personal Jarvis（[为什么改名](https://dodaios.ai/blog/personal-jarvis-is-now-dodaios/)）。赞助者见 [SPONSORS.md](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/blob/main/SPONSORS.md)。
